item.title: PDF Digital Signature Invalidation Rules: What Changes Break the Seal
item.description:
“PDF Digital Signature Invalidation Rules: What Changes Break the Seal”

When dealing with digitally signed or certified PDF documents, precision regarding subsequent modifications is paramount. Any alteration to the document’s content can compromise the cryptographic seal. How exactly do different levels of certification—or the lack thereof—dictate what subsequent operations are permissible without invalidating the existing signature?

Specifically, when a document is signed, what actions, such as supplying form field values, adding annotations, or—critically—adding entirely new pages, are permitted under various Adobe Acrobat certification levels?
